description.narrative: There are three primary objectives of the scheme: • To facilitate the creation of at least 100 long-term, sustainable university partnerships. • To provide strategic support for Ukrainian institutions, academics, and students to help ensure institutions can continue to operate during the conflict. • To help sustain capacity and capability in Ukraine which maximises the potential contribution higher education can make to post-war reconstruction.

participating-org.narrative: Cormack Consultancy Group is the consultancy service in higher education sector, the main sphere of activity is internationalization. CCG operates since 1999 and has established over 900 partnerships all over the world, develops international strategies, helps to establish TNE cooperation and provides other services on the institutional and state level.

description.narrative: 1) Information events for the universities in twinning and to engage universities, who are not yet in twinning (10 events) 2) Managing the twinning database (120 hours) 3) Explanatory and preparatory calls for UK universities about twinning (100 calls) 4) Twinning meeting to identify potential twin (24 meetings) 5) Emailing for approval from both universities (including chasing) (over 160 emails) 6) Introductory call, preparation, call and follow up notes (80 into calls) 7) Arranging follow up call (196 follow up calls) 8) Follow up call, Agenda, preparation, call and follow up notes (196 follow up calls) Dissemination of the opportunities for Ukrainian researchers and students (weekly, 24 reach out to 144 registered UA universities) 10) Preparation and signing of twinning agreement (35 MOUs) 11) Arranging monthly follow up calls (8 monthly calls) 12) Chairing follow up calls, preparation, call and follow up notes (8 monthly calls) 13) Communication on the twinning (interviews, social media, press releases, newsletter, publications, monthly statements) (1-2 times a week at average, 36 outreaches) 14) Communication with UA/UK twinning stakeholders (twice a week, 48 meetings) 15) Web page on Twinning development
